messages:
maria: FYI incoming pen test scheduled Wed 2025-10-15 10:00-16:00 UTC. We need a brief RBAC freeze window + scoped KMS access for assessors. Draft checklist below, please :eyes: and ack.
jon: Ack. Can you confirm which roles will be frozen and whether we need any temporary service principals?
maria: Proposing: freeze role creation/assignment for org-admins and infra-deployers from 09:45-16:30 UTC. Allow assessor ephemeral role via IAM STS only (preprovisioned ARNs). No new service principals during window unless emergency.
kevin: For KMS: we'll open a read-only KMS proxy for key metadata + GetPublicKey, but deny Decrypt/Encrypt. Assessors will need to verify key rotation policy and audits — not key material. Does that satisfy the scope?
maria: Yes. We want them to be able to verify key usage logs and rotation history, not decrypt anything. Also need CloudTrail export sample for the last 90 days.
tara: Product side: confirm we won't accidentally block canary pipelines. We need a safelist of CI service accounts that must remain active.
jon: Add these to the safelist: ci-runner, canary-watchdog, deploy-bot. I'll prepare a patch to the freeze playbook to exclude them.
alex: Oncall: I'll be available during the window. If an emergency RBAC exception is needed, use the escalation channel and tag me + sec-lead.
maria: Checklist (short):
- RBAC freeze enacted (roles: org-admin, infra-deployer)
- Ephemeral assessor ARNs created and shared via Readroom (encrypted link)
- KMS proxy with metadata-only permissions + CloudTrail sample exported
- Audit log snapshot uploaded to evidence-bucket (retention tag: pen-test-2025)
- Safelist for CI services added
- Retest slot requested (48-72h)
- Post-test remediation tracker created in vuln-tracker project
kevin: Quick KMS config snippet for proxy policy (example):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:DescribeKey","kms:GetKeyRotationStatus","kms:GetPublicKey"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:...:key/*" },
    { "Effect": "Deny", "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:...:key/*" }
  ]
}
```
kevin: And a quick AWS CLI to enumerate keys auditors can use: `aws kms list-keys --profile pen-test-readonly`
maria: Evidence upload convention: `s3://evidence-bucket/pen-test-2025/<org>/<artifact>.tgz` — include manifest.json with MD5s.
tara: For remediation tracking: can we use vuln-tracker epic PT-2025-10? I'll own coordinating with squads for fixes and retest signoffs.
maria: Yes, please create PT-2025-10 epic and add affected owners. Retest policy: fixes >= severity 7 require 1-week freeze and automated regression evals; lower severities get 48-72h retest window.
alex: Minor ops question: who gives the final greenlight to lift the RBAC freeze? We should document a single approver to avoid race conditions.
jon: Final lift: sec-lead or infra-eng director. I'll add a step: approver posts `RBAC_FREEZE_LIFTED` in this thread and runs the rollback script.
maria: I've uploaded assessor ARNs and CloudTrail sample links to the evidence readroom (link: https://readroom.redwood.local/pen-test-2025). pt-bot: can you create a vuln-tracker epic and a retest calendar entry?
pt-bot: Created epic PT-2025-10 (https://vuln.redwood.local/epic/PT-2025-10) and scheduled tentative retest slot 2025-10-17 10:00-14:00 UTC. Notified owners: tara, kevin, jon.
kevin: I'll put the KMS proxy in a staged config and run through the permissions audit today EOD.
tara: I'll spin up a canary run tomorrow against safelisted services to validate nothing breaks.
maria: Thanks all. Please ack when tasks are done. Final reminder: no key material access allowed for assessors. :lock:
jon: ack
kevin: ack
tara: ack
alex: ack
